name: TRUST/HEART -SOUL LIBERATION-
source:
Summer of 2020. Japan has started to deploy Mental Connect Network System as a new layer over Web. It allows human mind and senses to fly through the network and experience a more realistic virtual world .

Main character is a division chief in a major computer company. His everyday life gets disturbed by... soul liberation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2020年夏，日本开始在现有网络之上部署一套全新的“精神连接网络系统”。它能让人的意识与感官畅游网络，体验更加真实的虚拟世界。

主人公是一家大型计算机公司的部门主管。他的日常生活却因……灵魂解放而被打乱。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
